text:
Lena: Quick tally on the cohort-B plan: unify 30/90 -> 60d default and add automated 'pin decay' for low-touch tenants. Want decision before next sprint cutoff.

Nate: Runtime OK but need concrete thresholds. Suggest: token_usage < 200k/month AND no eval regression in 30d window.

Priya: Product: add acceptance gates: bench delta <= 2%, rollback < 15m, comm + opt-out UI. Who owns comms?

Raj: I'll own the feature-flag and sim harness. Canary proposal: 3 internal tenants + 2 light customers, 10d shadow then 7d live.

Ivy: Ops: require trace hooks and a one-click rollback. Also alert if 99p latency increases >10% or model mismatch rate >5%.

Priya: Also need legal-approved exception list for enterprise pins. Auto-enroll SMBs after notice.

Raj: Example canary config (pseudo):
```json
{"pin_decay":{"enabled":true,"grace_days":60,"usage_threshold_month":200000,"min_retention_days":14,"shadow_days":10,"live_days":7,"rollback_sla_mins":15}}
```

Nate: +1. Add KV cache priming job post-decay to avoid regen spikes.

Lena: Action items: Raj implement flag + sim (Raj, Thu EOD); Ivy add alerts & rollback script (Ivy, Fri); Priya draft comms + exception list (Priya, Mon). I'll schedule a 30m review after 1 week of canary.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/pin-decay -> staging 2026-04-05T04:00Z (dry-run).

Lena: Thanks — feel free to ping if blockers.
